T:P1.7.text: Marc Jacobs is an iconic American fashion house known for its fearless designs and playful approach to luxury. Since its inception the brand has created a lasting impact on the fashion industry, becoming synonymous with creativity, individuality, and timeless craftsmanship. Marc Jacobs continues to influence the world of fashion with its innovative vision and bold approach to style.

C:P2.3.text: Vince crafts understated luxury from California. Our design atelier was established in Los Angeles to capture the storied freedom and effortless allure of life on the coast. Lasting materials — rich, buttery leather, plush cashmere, incandescent silk and the softest wool — are rendered with exacting precision and nuanced details that make each piece feel personal.

C:P2.4.text: Quiet sophistication is found in our foundational heroes, which move through spaces, seasons, occasions, and phases of one’s life with ease. Spirited standouts are distinguished by texture, color, and pattern. Since our founding every addition to our women’s and men’s ready-to-wear, accessories and home collection is crafted to inspire a timeless confidence, allowing one to think more clearly and creatively — the truest luxury. This is Vince.
